# The Commonwealth

> > The Commonwealth is an international association of 56 member countries supporting democracy, development, and cooperation across diverse nations.

The Commonwealth Secretariat, headquartered at Marlborough House in London, coordinates activities including the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM), youth engagement programs, and initiatives on governance, development, and small states. Led by Secretary-General Kamalesh Sharma during this period, the organization promotes shared values through events like Commonwealth Day and partnerships with institutions like the World Bank.

## Key Topics

- Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM)
- Secretary-General Kamalesh Sharma
- Commonwealth Secretariat
- Youth engagement and leadership
- Commonwealth Charter
- Queen Elizabeth II and Diamond Jubilee
- Commonwealth Day celebrations
- Commonwealth Ministerial Action Group (CMAG)
- Eminent Persons Group (EPG)
- Small states development
- Democracy and governance
- Rule of law
- Sustainable development
- Women's empowerment
- Election monitoring
